attempts.rationale: The diagnosis flags unstable ranking and suggests a robust combination; use inverse-error weighting across the full pool.

test a different combination type by using a softmax weight which may handle unstable ranking better while still weighting by error.

decision.justification: Selected 'median' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 0.9742. Series context: trend strength 0.9787 and seasonal strength 0.5117; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau -0.17); 4 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 0.363.
